landing.hero: Minimalist cream background with the vibrant peacock logo gradient subtly glowing. Bold Clash Display heading 'Every Skilled People Ka Single Platform'. Large search bar with category pills below. 'Get Started' CTA using the brand gradient button.
landing.featured_artists: Horizontal scroll of 'story-style' circular avatars (Instagram inspired) with the gradient border.
landing.categories: Bento grid of categories with soft off-white cards, dark text, and subtle hover lifts.

artist_listing.layout: Sidebar for filters (Category, Location, Rating, Price) on desktop. Grid of artist cards on right.
artist_listing.artist_card: Instagram-style card. Top: Avatar, Name, Blue Tick, City. Middle: 4-item portfolio grid. Bottom: Rating stars, 'View Profile' button.

artist_profile.layout: Centered maximum 3xl container. Top section: Large Avatar, Name, Blue Tick, Bio, Rating, Follower count. CTA: 'Message via Platform' (brand gradient).
artist_profile.portfolio: Masonry or tight grid of images/videos. No contact info visible.
artist_profile.reviews: Clean list of customer reviews with star ratings.

customer_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (Profile, Wallet, My Requirements, Bookings). Main content area with white cards on the cream background.
customer_dashboard.wallet: Card showing balance, 'Add Money' button, transaction history.
customer_dashboard.create_requirement: Clean form to post a job (Title, Category, Budget, Description).

artist_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (Profile Editor, Opportunities, My Bookings, Earnings).
artist_dashboard.profile_editor: Form to update bio, upload exactly 4 portfolio items, connect IG account.

login.layout: Centered card on a subtle gradient background. Mobile-first view. 'Enter Mobile Number', 'Send OTP', 'Verify' flow. Role selection toggle (Artist vs Customer) after OTP.

hero_backgrounds.description: Premium brand gradient abstract background for hero section accents
Cream textured background for premium subtle sections

categories_and_portfolios.description: Indian dancer performance (Dance & Music / Performing Arts)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the marketing landing page (no Shadcn rigid layouts).
Use Shadcn components for dashboards, forms, and settings but styled to match the premium cream/white theme without harsh shadows.
Ensure the Blue Tick is visibly prominent on verified artist profiles.
Implement the EXACT 4-item Instagram-style grid for the artist portfolios.
Do not display any phone numbers or emails on the public artist profile; use the 'Message via Platform' flow.
Inject the logo's peacock color palette strictly as accents (buttons, active states, badges), keeping the primary UI minimal and neutral.
